page_title: Plantix | #1 FREE app for crop diagnosis and treatments

sources.entry: Plantix - AI plant doctor that diagnoses plant diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies from photos taken by farmers. #free

summary.name: Plantix
summary.one_liner: Plantix is a free app that diagnoses crop diseases, pests and problems from a photo of a sick plant and suggests treatments.
use_cases: Diagnosing a sick crop from a photo
Finding chemical or biological treatments for crop disease
Asking an agronomist community about crop problems
Learning crop cultivation and disease prevention
Looking up specific crop diseases in a library
summary.what_it_does: Users take a photo of a sick crop and the app returns a diagnosis and treatment suggestions, which the page says takes a few seconds. The page says the app covers crop diseases, and the directory listing adds pests and nutrient deficiencies. A community of agri-experts can answer farmers' questions, and users can share their own experience. A library describes specific crop diseases and prevention methods. The page claims more than 150 million crop-related questions answered and says the app is the most downloaded ag-tech app worldwide. It also lists a business offering called Plantix Intelligence.
notable: Photo-based diagnosis with treatment suggestions in seconds
Library of crop diseases and prevention methods
caveats: Page does not name supported platforms beyond calling it an app
Page does not state which crops or regions are covered
Business offering (Plantix Intelligence) details are not described on the page
